```sql
SELECT 
    "School Name",
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
FROM main."frpm"
WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
ORDER BY "School Name"
```
